memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: These are the clans of Noah's sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood. - Gen 10:32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The Table of Nations closes with a sweeping summary: "From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood." What began with three sons stepping out of the ark became, in time, all the nations of the world. This single verse steps back to show us the grand scope of God's work - a whole world of peoples, all flowing from one family, all under the one God who made them.

There is something awe-inspiring in this bird's-eye view. Every nation that has ever existed, every people group, every culture and language across all of history - all of it traces back to this moment, and behind it, to the purposes of God. The astonishing tapestry of humanity is not a random sprawl; it is the outworking of God's design to fill the earth with people who bear His image.

This should fill us with wonder at God's greatness and with love for His world. The God we worship is not small or tribal. He is the Lord of all the nations, the Maker of every people, the One whose purposes span the entire globe and all of history.

And the Table of Nations is not merely a record of the past; it points to the future. God's heart has always been for all these nations to know Him. The great commission sends us to "make disciples of all nations" (Matt 28:19), and the final vision of Scripture shows a countless multitude "from every nation" worshipping before the throne (Rev 7:9). From one family came all the nations - and to that one Saviour, one day, all the nations will come. What a God we serve.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Does your vision of God match His heart for all the nations?
- How can you play a part in God's purpose to reach every people?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord of all the nations, thank You that from one family You brought forth all the peoples of the earth, and that Your heart is for them all to know You. Enlarge my vision, and let me share Your love for the whole world, for the glory of Christ.
